answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond to open one identity, like a tree in an orchard: by a sonnet-fixed rule the bond decays 5% per epoch unless verified work renews it, and below 20 POA the identity locks. 1,000 fake identities lock 60,000 POA, and idle decay burns 3,000 POA per epoch against a 12,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share on the terrace.
